reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount helper with only provider data, and the balance branch is shared with akahu, but the download side writes a new function instead of generalising the existing ones.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a line-for-line copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (and nearly of downloadPluggyAiTransactions), differing only in the server URL and log string.

placement.why: Provider pieces sit where the other providers' do (server-config, sync.ts, accounts/app.ts, types/models), but 'fintegra' is added by widening LinkBankSyncAccountParams.syncSource locally to AccountSyncSource | 'fintegra' instead of adding it to the shared BankSyncProviders/AccountSyncSource type.

scope.why: Only the server-side provider wiring, its type and tests; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: The link path is clean, but a fourth copy of the download function and a sync source missing from the canonical union type will drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: LinkBankSyncAccountParams.syncSource in accounts/app.ts is widened with an ad-hoc 'fintegra' literal instead of extending AccountSyncSource/BankSyncProviders

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in accounts/sync.ts is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, not disguised
